<reason>A won by holding the motion as written: average parity plus policy that reflects that evidence. B’s confound argument was strong, but B then admitted the “fair” stable-from-birth comparison is not in large files, which A turned into an unmet burden rather than a license to presume equality. A also absorbed B’s best policy hit by refusing limbo while still defending ranking when both homes are available.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Rebuttal 2/closing use of B’s A1 (“Not in the form those files allow”), converting B’s own fair-comparison standard into a missing-evidence problem for the proposition.</best_rebuttal>
